Question: What is the loss ratio, number of claims, total loss by policy number and premium where total loss is the sum of loss payment, loss reserve, expense payment, expense reserve amount and loss ratio is total loss divided by premium?
Generated Query:
WITH loss_amounts AS (
    SELECT
        ca.Claim_Identifier,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(ca.Claim_Amount, 0)
                WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(ca.Claim_Amount, 0)
                WHEN ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(ca.Claim_Amount, 0)
                WHEN er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(ca.Claim_Amount, 0)
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS total_loss
    FROM Claim_Amount ca
    LEFT JOIN Loss_Payment lp
        ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Loss_Reserve lr
        ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Expense_Payment ep
        ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Expense_Reserve er
        ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = er.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
),
claim_policy AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        c.Claim_Identifier,
        p.Policy_Identifier,
        p.Policy_Number
    FROM Claim c
    JOIN Claim_Coverage cc
        ON c.Claim_Identifier = cc.Claim_Identifier
    JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
        ON cc.Effective_Date = pcd.Effective_Date
       AND cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
    JOIN Policy p
        ON pcd.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
),
policy_premium AS (
    SELECT
        p.Policy_Identifier,
        p.Policy_Number,
        SUM(COALESCE(pa.Policy_Amount, 0)) AS premium
    FROM Policy p
    JOIN Policy_Amount pa
        ON p.Policy_Identifier = pa.Policy_Identifier
    JOIN Premium pr
        ON pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY p.Policy_Identifier, p.Policy_Number
)
SELECT
    cp.Policy_Number,
    pp.premium,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cp.Claim_Identifier) AS number_of_claims,
    SUM(COALESCE(la.total_loss, 0)) AS total_loss,
    CASE
        WHEN pp.premium = 0 OR pp.premium IS NULL THEN NULL
        ELSE SUM(COALESCE(la.total_loss, 0)) / pp.premium
    END AS loss_ratio
FROM claim_policy cp
LEFT JOIN loss_amounts la
    ON cp.Claim_Identifier = la.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN policy_premium pp
    ON cp.Policy_Identifier = pp.Policy_Identifier
   AND cp.Policy_Number = pp.Policy_Number
GROUP BY cp.Policy_Number, pp.premium
ORDER BY cp.Policy_Number;

JOIN Agreement_Party_Role apr

    c.Company_Claim_Number,
    c.Claim_Identifier,
    COALESCE(SUM(
        CASE

              OR lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL
              OR ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL
              OR er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL
            THEN ca.Claim_Amount

        END

LEFT JOIN Loss_Payment lp
